title: The Hadza Gut Gap Has Two Powerful Causes
hook: Hunter-gatherer guts gain diversity while modern habits strip it away.
closing: Fiber feeds gut diversity, while unnecessary antibiotics can erase what diet builds.
question: How much fiber did you eat?

segments.say: The Hadza carry about 730 gut bacteria species. Their guts support far more diversity than the average American's.
The Hadza eat 150 grams of fiber daily. That abundance feeds the bacteria behind their diversity.
About 34% of US antibiotic prescriptions are unnecessary. Modern medicine can erase diversity that fiber helps build.
